svg.title: All north-south traffic goes through the gateway chassis

desc.style: fill:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke:none;color:rgb(11, 11, 11);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:anthropic-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto

svg.desc: A VM without a floating IP and a VM with a floating IP both send external traffic through a Geneve tunnel to the gateway network node, where SNAT or floating IP NAT happens, before it reaches the external network. Replies and inbound traffic take the same path in reverse.
